main_text.l: pter lingvæ diversitatem appellarunt Cambros voce Germanicâ Wallos, quâ hodieqve utimur in denotandis hominibus barbaræ & nobis non intellectæ lingvæ.
Canon. Omnia regna Britannicæ sunt conjuncta.

A. C. 1603. post obitum Elisabethæ Jacobus IV Rex Scotiæ universam Britanniam i. e. 360 Insulas uno Imperio, quod ab orbe condito non fuerat factum, fuit complexus, atque abrogato Angliæ ac Scotiæ nomine universam Insulam Magnam Britanniam appellari voluit. Ei successit A. C. 1624 filius Carolus.

page.notes: The asterisk-like mark after "appellarunt" has no matching note on the page. "360" is printed with a long-s-like 3 and may be misread. The catchword "tò" completes "aliquantò" with the word broken at the line end. The marginal note "quære- gna post bre" is cut off at the edge; "bre" is uncertain. Headings "Periodus IV." and "Periodus V." are set as level-2 divisions; "Canon." lines are kept as paragraphs.
